column1: # ZAP baseline ignore-list - the tripwire allow-list.
# Format: <pluginId><TAB>IGNORE   Lines starting with # are comments; blank lines ignored.
# (Two columns only. A third column would be a URL regex, NOT a comment - keep notes here.)
# Each id is a DOCUMENTED ACCEPTED RISK in SECURITY-NOTES.md, confirmed present on production
# by a fresh scan (2026-07-28). IGNORE = the scan stays silent about it. With fail_action:true
# in zap-baseline.yml, ANY alert NOT listed here turns the run red. Known-accepted = quiet;
# anything new = loud. To accept a NEW risk: add its id here AND a note in SECURITY-NOTES.md.
#   10055 = CSP unsafe-inline (script/style)      -> accepted risk #1 (zero-build app, no nonces)
#   90003 = Subresource Integrity missing         -> accepted risk #2 (Google Fonts UA-variant CSS)
#   90004 = Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy missing  -> accepted risk #3 (no cross-origin isolation)
#   10027 = Information Disclosure: Suspicious Comments -> accepted risk #5 (public repo)
#   10015 = Re-examine Cache-control              -> accepted risk #4 (single-file PWA strategy)
#   10049 = Storable but Non-Cacheable            -> accepted risk #4 (same strategy)
#   10109 = Modern Web Application                -> informational detection, not a vulnerability
